blocks.text: The new restaurant on opening evening. KASUN stands by the door, adjusting his shirt, nervous.
A car stops outside. ANUDI'S FATHER steps out and looks up at the sign.
ඔව් සර්. මම ඔයා එනකල් බලා හිටියා.
blocks.speaker: Kasun

blocks.text: The father looks around the room, then at Kasun. He nods, once.

treatment.logline: On his restaurant’s opening evening, Kasun greets Anudi’s father at the door; a quiet question and a steady answer end with a single, hard-won nod.

arc.feeling: Kasun holds his nerves as the new space breathes around him
A measured appraisal from the outside world
Pride without show; ownership, simply stated
A nod that lands warmer than any speech

treatment.approach: Threshold cinema: frame the doorway as the border between two worlds — cool evening street and warm interior. Lenses: 24–35mm for spatial context and doorway compositions; 50mm OTS to bridge across the threshold; 85mm for faces at the turns. Movement is minimal and motivated: a slow push for Kasun’s claim, a gentle pan for the father’s survey of the room; otherwise locked-off for poise. Layer frames with foreground tables, doorframe and glass to give depth and separation.

treatment.geography: Door is frame-right of the interior; dining room opens left with tables and hanging lamps; counter deeper left. Street and curb run right-to-left outside. The axis is the line through the doorway between Kasun (inside) and the father (outside). We stay on the interior side of this axis for all dialogue and reactions, using OTS from outside over the father’s right shoulder toward Kasun; the exterior wide keeps the restaurant on screen-left and the father on screen-right to preserve orientation. No accidental line crosses; the sign insert acts as a neutral anchor when cutting between interior and exterior.
treatment.key_image: The father, half-silhouetted in the doorway against the night, nodding once as the restaurant’s warm light holds steady behind Kasun.
advice: If you prefer to play L2 on the father’s face rather than on Kasun’s reaction, swap Shot 5 to a CU of the father; the rest of the geometry holds.
If you want the father to step inside before he nods, add a [move] block after L3 so we can cross the threshold honestly.
We avoid readable text on the sign; if its words must be seen, plan an insert with designed artwork or a separate pickup.
